title: Peace on Earth
old_p1: Long before Jesus was born, Isaiah, a prophet who spoke for Heavenly Father, said a child would be born, called the Prince of Peace. A prince is a king’s son.
The night Jesus was born, an angel, a messenger from Heavenly Father, told the shepherds the happy news.
Suddenly, many angels were there, praising Heavenly Father. Praising means saying how great and good He is.
old_p2: The angels said, “Glory to Heavenly Father in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.” Peace is a calm, safe feeling inside. Good will means kindness to everyone. We sing their words in Christmas songs!
Tonight, lie very still. Jesus, the Prince of Peace, can fill your heart with peace.
p1: Long before Jesus was born, Isaiah said a special child would come. He would be called the Prince of Peace.
The night Jesus was born, an angel told the shepherds the happy news.
Suddenly, many, many angels were there with him! They were praising Heavenly Father, telling how great and good He is.
p2: The angels said, “Glory to Heavenly Father in the highest!” They said, “On earth peace, good will toward men.” Jesus came to bring peace, a calm, safe feeling deep inside. He came to teach kindness to everyone, too.
Kind words help bring peace. Tonight, lie very still and feel calm inside. Tomorrow, share a kind word, just like the angels shared good news.
